verdict.rationale: Claude documents broad file upload support (PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, TXT, HTML, ODT, RTF, EPUB, JSON) and explicitly analyzes both text and visual elements in PDFs up to 100 pages, plus Projects for knowledge-base workspaces to analyze documents in context. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks specifically validating accuracy of spreadsheet/PDF analysis (community evidence cited is about coding/research, not document analysis) and no documented limits/accuracy caveats for very large or complex spreadsheets.
